issues.description: Element: SELECT aggregate expression for Aufgabe 05 (aufgabe05.sql). The problem statement (problem_statement.md) asks for the average area of municipalities per Kreis and to show the Kreis name and its Regierungsbezirk. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql) selects regierungsbezirk, kreis, COUNT(flaeche) and groups by regierungsbezirk, kreis, which computes a count rather than the requested average. This contradicts the stated requirement and will confuse students about which aggregation to use and what the expected output columns are.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to compute the average area using AVG(flaeche) and ensure the output includes kreis and regierungsbezirk. For example: SELECT kreis, regierungsbezirk, AVG(flaeche) AS durchschnittliche_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY kreis, regierungsbezirk ORDER BY kreis; Ensure the solution matches the problem text and the expected columns and aggregation.
